frozen_before_v15_reruns: 2026-09-28; identical architecture and seeds to M7 after input-causality correction
environment: system Python 3.13 torch 2.12.1 CPU, MPS unavailable; existing validation venv Python 3.12 numpy/scipy
condition: D1 v1.5 20Ah native P1 fragment selected and quality-gated entirely through first raw >=3.50V crossing, persistent past15 events, six-cell 180 fixed targets
source: d1_v15_target_visibility.csv, d1_v15_cropped_events.csv and M9_D1_v15_inputs_v1/native_sequences.npz; event ID ends at simulated shallow endpoint, never use later complete-event quality or target discharge
padding: left zero pad, no interpolation or upsampling, 30s native resolution
outer_split: leave one physical P1 cell out; exclude entire held cell from unsupervised pretraining and supervised head fitting
inner_split: for PCA and age/count ridge, refit the unsupervised transform on four inner training cells and select alpha by leave-one-training-cell-out; TCN downstream ridge alpha fixed at 10 before runs to avoid inner validation-cell unlabeled pretraining exposure
linear_baseline: PCA/SVD of training event waveforms, 16 dimensions, frozen event embedding; same downstream ridge head
PCA_negative_control: zero voltage channel during unsupervised fit and transform, retain I/T/q/mask

temporal_encoder.self_supervised_task: predict next native voltage increment in mV from current and earlier samples only

capacity_residual_rule: TCN heads predict an additive correction to the fold-trained age/count ridge prior; correction bounded +/-10 SOH pp using tanh for neural heads and clipping for frozen ridge, same rule for pretrained and scratch
score: P1 single-cell 0.5C/1C discharge capacity proxy in SOH pp; not official 4S C/20
target_held_event_reconstruction: unlabeled diagnostic only, not pretrain selection or tuning
claim_limit: same six development cells used in prior exploration; no independent D2 confirmation
